messages:
mike (pm): quick sync — i’m calling this a 'dep tetris' thread. customer wants a private pilot next month but staging capacity + security signoff are tight. can runtime/infra/security align on minimum launch criteria and owners?
vikram (eng-platform): we can carve out 2 staging slots for the pilot week but need infra to confirm GPU commit and prewarm windows.
sam (infra): i can commit 2x A10G for pilot window if we get finalized slot dates + ticket for networking (vpc peering + egress rules). need KMS onboarding from security.
tess (security): HSM/KMS review will be blocking if not started. we need dataflow diagram + threat model; estimate 5 business days for KMS/HSM review once materials are in.
emily (runtime): runtime can do batching+kv-cache tuning and a quantization profile to cut cost, but we need a pinned model sha and representative traffic shape. perf tests take ~48h to run after model is frozen.
chris (eng-sre): ops items: canary route, fallback to hosted smaller model, and alerting thresholds. i’ll write runbook for incident playbook but need SLO targets from product.
jana (prod): customer is asking for a 99.9% SLA and ~120ms p95 on chat responses. i know that’s aggressive — can we be realistic for pilot?
vikram (eng-platform): 120ms p95 on private infra with A10s + quant probably unrealistic for first wave. propose we set pilot SLO to 250ms p95 and iterate.
mike (pm): okay — proposal: launch gate checklist (minimal) — please ack/own if possible:
```
- model pinned (sha) -> owner: product/ML
- staging smoke passed (end-to-end) -> owner: eng-platform + runtime
- KMS/HSM security signoff -> owner: security
- staging capacity reserved (2 slots) -> owner: infra
- canary + fallback routes + runbook -> owner: eng-sre
- perf run (48h) with representative traffic -> owner: runtime
- agreed pilot SLO: 250ms p95, 99.9% availability -> owner: product + eng-sre
- rollback plan documented -> owner: eng-platform
```
vikram (eng-platform): can own the staging smoke + rollback plan. target to finish smoke by Tue 1718290000 (next week).
sam (infra): confirming GPU commit once ticket with dates + vpc details exists. i’ll also scope prewarm window (we charge burst credits for extended prewarm).
tess (security): i'll start the KMS checklist now. can someone drop a simple dataflow diagram in the ticket? i’ll slot review for Thu if we have docs by EOD Wed.
emily (runtime): once model is pinned i’ll schedule perf runs. i’ll need a small test harness and a 10k-message sample. can ops host the harness?
chris (eng-sre): ops can host. also recommend we add an automatic fallback rule to route 10% of traffic to hosted model if latency exceeds threshold during canary. reduces risk.
jana (prod): i’ll sync with customer on SLOs and set expectations for pilot: 250ms target + known caveats. will confirm acceptance criteria by Wednesday.
mike (pm): thanks — can everyone react with :thumbsup: if you accept the owners/timeline. otherwise call out open risks.
vikram (eng-platform): :thumbsup:
emily (runtime): :thumbsup:
sam (infra): :thumbsup: starting the infra ticket now -> link: https://redwood.example.com/ticket/PI-4821
tess (security): :thumbsup: will post review slot + checklist in the ticket.
chris (eng-sre): noted — will draft runbook and add alert thresholds.
jana (prod): adding customer note to the ticket.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled to staging-slot-2 on 1718290000 by eng-platform (auto-schedule).
mike (pm): great — followups: vikram to update ticket with exact smoke test steps, emily to post perf harness link, tess to confirm review window. we’ll retouch Thurs 15:00 for a short status check.
vikram (eng-platform): on it. meeting noted.
